source: re-evaluation re-digitisation, 2026-10-19: Fig. 4 (p.11) rendered at 400 dpi; appearance/drop columns of each coloured range trace located in pixels (axis 0..10000 slots = 883 px, ~11 slots/px, line width ~3 px => +-25 slots). Measured (born, drop): T2 (0, 3035), T3 (1721, 4745), T1 (2016, 5040), T5 (6048, 9083), T1b (6161, ~9160: range reaches 0 at ~9000 and rises to ~0.4 km before the drop), T4 (6761, 9796). Every measured window is within 45 slots of the 3000-slot lifetime (paper §VII-A2), so each window (except T2, present from slot 0) is set to removed = born + 3000 centred on the measurement. T1b keeps the full path start (-6000, 5500) -> end (0, 0) (the radar), now over [6160, 9160): it reaches the radar at removal instead of at slot ~9000. Figs. 3/4 suggest the target overflies the radar by ~450 m in its last ~160 slots; that reading is scenario_case1_v2_overflight.json (--replica v2o), a labelled sensitivity: the polar EKF diverges at the overflight (estimated range -> 1e7 m while the filter covariance stays small) and every r_hat-driven baseline (DA, OA) then pours its budget into that track (see the README). Positions unchanged (Fig. 3, +-500 m). Previous schedule: scenario_case1_v1.json (full-run numbers). Straight CV segments start->end over [born, removed).
